hobbies.name: Mountain Biking
hobbies.description: Experience the thrill of riding through scenic mountain trails and challenging terrain. A hobby that combines adventure, fitness, and nature.

hobbies.name: Photography
hobbies.description: Explore the world through the camera lens and learn to capture people, nature, architecture, and everyday moments.

hobbies.name: Running
hobbies.description: A simple hobby that works almost anywhere. Start at your own pace and discover the benefits of moving outdoors.

hobbies.name: Dancing classes
hobbies.description: Learn new moves, express yourself to music, and meet people through different dance styles.

hobbies.name: Sailing
hobbies.description: Experience the wind, the sea, and the feeling of steering a sailboat yourself. A hobby combining nature, technique, and adventure.

hobbies.name: Pottery
hobbies.description: Shape clay into mugs, bowls, figurines, and other creative projects. A peaceful hobby where you create something with your hands.

hobbies.name: Crochet
hobbies.description: Create everything from small decorations to clothes and blankets using yarn and a crochet hook.

hobbies.name: Painting
hobbies.description: Unleash your creativity and experiment with colors, shapes, and different techniques.

hobbies.name: Swimming
hobbies.description: A versatile form of exercise that can be both relaxing and intense. Great for anyone looking to train the whole body.

hobbies.name: Guitar lessons
hobbies.description: Learn to play the guitar and discover music in a whole new way. You can start with simple songs and improve over time.

hobbies.name: Learning chess
hobbies.description: Develop your strategic thinking through a classic game where every move counts.

hobbies.name: Yoga
hobbies.description: Combine movement, balance, and relaxation through various yoga poses and exercises.

hobbies.name: Darts
hobbies.description: Test your precision and focus with darts. A hobby suitable for both competitive play and social evenings.

hobbies.name: Disc golf
hobbies.description: Combine walks and precision by throwing discs toward baskets on a disc golf course.

hobbies.name: Sourdough baking
hobbies.description: Learn to bake bread with sourdough and discover the process behind creating delicious, crusty bread.

hobbies.name: Climbing
hobbies.description: A challenge for both body and mind. Climbing is about strength, balance, problem-solving, and daring to try new paths.
